payload.body: docs/guide.md is the how-to surface for new humans and agents: an entry-condition router (ask-matt pattern: organize by starting situation, describe by problem state, link deeper instead of inlining) around two GENERATOR-OWNED marked regions — the 25-verb CLI table projected from the src/cli.ts COMMANDS registry and the 18-workflow /nd:* table from nahel/workflows frontmatter. Freshness mechanism (cross-agent grill, codex counter accepted over claude's drift-test draft): a repo script regenerates the marked regions byte-identically and a bun test runs it in check mode — no markdown parsing, no new CLI verb; prose outside the markers is never generator-touched. Implementation is work item jkvadyhz (open). Maintenance rule lives in the doc itself.
